title: Toyota Land Cruiser Engines by Year
description: Every factory engine in the US Toyota Land Cruiser by year: the F and 2F sixes of the FJ40 and FJ60, the 3F-E and 1FZ-FE, the 4.7 and 5.7 V8s, and the 2024+ hybrid.
intro: Toyota has sold the Land Cruiser in the US since 1958, from the FJ40 to the 250 series that returned for 2024 after a two-year gap. Only engines sold new in the US are listed.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: FJ25 / FJ40
intro: The early Land Cruisers used Toyota's F inline six, replaced by the 2F in 1975.

generations.name: 80 series
intro: The 3F-E and, from 1993, the 4.5 1FZ-FE twin-cam six.

generations.name: 250 series
intro: The i-FORCE MAX hybrid, rated for the combined output of the 2.4 turbo four and motor.
